Ministry of Finance: This is the government ministry in Bangladesh responsible for the administration of internal resource division, customs, and value added tax matters.
Internal Resources Division: This is the administrative department under the Ministry of Finance tasked with policy-making and oversight of customs and value added tax regulations.
Government of Bangladesh: This constitutes the sovereign authority issuing the regulatory notification.

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of this Act grants the government the authority to issue notifications and amend previous orders in the public interest.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of this Act provides the legal power for the government to exercise regulatory functions in consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
National Board of Revenue: The government is required to consult with this board when exercising its powers to issue or amend regulatory notifications concerning customs and taxes.
S.R.O. 158-AIN/2017: This existing notification is being amended through the current S.R.O. to update specific tariff descriptions within its attached table.
H.S. Code: The H.S. Code 7304.39.90 and its associated description previously listed in the table are being replaced with H.S. Code 7304.39.00.
TABLE: The table attached to the notification is amended by substituting the existing entry for a specific seamless pipe classification with a new entry.
